title: EXIT NINE — 开发历程 / Development history

entries.title: 策划起点：夜班辨伪
entries.summary: 从“资料正确，身体却不对劲”的住户辨认，逐渐确定夜班工作与有限探索的方向。
changes: 先写背景、GDD与事件剧本；此阶段没有游戏程序。
确定复古低保真恐怖、单人第一人称和浏览器试玩。
entries.summaryEn: The starting point was an ordinary night shift: correct personal records, but behavior that did not fit a human being.
changesEn: Background, GDD and event scripts came before the playable builds.
The direction settled on single-player, first-person observation and limited exploration in a browser.

entries.title: 最早白盒：夜班来电 0.1
entries.summary: 地点还是深夜小区。通过电话、档案、门禁和观察窗辨认住户。
changes: 完整事件00—05；两道门互锁，决定是否放行。
误放后补救、停电追踪、失败回档；基础灰盒和程序音效。
entries.summaryEn: The first playable version still takes place in a residential complex at night.
changesEn: Events 00–05 combine telephone calls, resident records, observation and interlocked access doors.
Includes a mistaken-admission recovery route, a power failure, pursuit and checkpoints. The scene is a functional greybox.

entries.title: 服务区原型：北松驿站 0.3
entries.summary: 搬到美国北部高速服务区，货车、后仓、营业区与加油区成为工作场地。
changes: 卸货、验货、抱箱补货、顾客辨认、假同事与加油求助。
改进开局指引和按阶段显示交互；高光对应货架格，抱箱可跑。
加入一套早期低多边形美术；此版人物和UI仍很基础。
entries.summaryEn: The project moves to a remote northern highway service station.
changesEn: Introduces unloading, inspections, carrying stock, customers, a false coworker and a fuel-pump request.
Improves onboarding and contextual interactions, with an early low-poly art pass.

entries.title: 第九出口 0.1：独立新项目
entries.summary: 保留前两个原型，另做第九出口。
changes: 重设计服务站布局与第一夜；参考夜班工作逐渐失控的节奏。
不是原作资产或地图的直接移植；这一阶段未找到完整代码快照。
entries.summaryEn: EXIT NINE becomes a separate project, preserving both earlier prototypes.
changesEn: A new shop layout and first night establish the rhythm of routine work becoming unsafe.
A complete executable snapshot of this stage was not retained.

entries.title: 0.2：人物比例与暖光
entries.summary: 围绕人物真实感、黄色店灯与整体复古质感重新迭代。
changes: 调整五官、衣服、人物比例和灯光；补充F2流程测试。
entries.summaryEn: A visual pass focuses on human proportions, faces and warmer shop lighting.
changesEn: Adds development flow checks. Only records of this stage survive.

entries.title: 0.3：让异常发生在现场
entries.summary: 从弹窗和文字提示转向面对面观察。
changes: 加入多样人物脸部素材与异常动作；改善抓取和收银交互。
核验身份与现实动作相互补充。
entries.summaryEn: Anomalies move from dialogue boxes into the physical scene.
changesEn: Distinct face textures, body behavior and improved grabbing support face-to-face observation.

entries.title: 0.4：营业与多名顾客
entries.summary: 从一个人进门直接交钱，改成挑选、排队与交易。
changes: 逐件扫描、现金、找零；增加第二、第三晚与收益。
加入门、放货、CCTV等不同声音。
entries.summaryEn: Customers begin browsing and queuing rather than immediately handing over money.
changesEn: Item scanning, cash, change, shop revenue and the second and third nights are added.
Doors, stocking and CCTV gain distinct sounds.

entries.title: 0.5：柜台与交互整理
entries.summary: 降低拿取现金和找零的操作负担。
changes: 调整L形柜台、固定找零视角、自动给零钱。
修门和房间的穿模、对话位置、重复动作与配饰。
entries.summaryEn: The counter and transaction flow are made easier to use.
changesEn: An L-shaped counter, a fixed change view and automatic handover of selected money reduce friction.
Door collisions, dialogue placement and repeated character actions are revised.

entries.title: 0.6：更细的动作与表情
entries.summary: 正常人更自然，伪人异常更有差异。
changes: 结账只高光当前步骤；不直接提示正确找零。
改进转身、抓取、五官与暴露后的表现。
entries.summaryEn: Normal movement and exposed impostor expressions receive more attention.
changesEn: Only the current checkout action is highlighted; the correct change is not revealed.
Turning, gripping, faces and transformation behavior are refined.

entries.title: 0.7：步态、异化与后院
entries.en: Gaits, transformations and the rear route
entries.summary: 扩充正常步态和伪人形态，增强电闸路线的压迫感。
changes: 推进12种步态与10种异化轮廓，加入不同程度的抽搐。
丰富杂草、垃圾桶、杂物和微弱引路光源。
entries.summaryEn: More human gait variants and distinct transformed silhouettes are developed.
changesEn: Head twitches, dense vegetation, bins, debris and faint lights make the breaker route more oppressive.

entries.title: 0.8：真正不同的商品
entries.summary: 三类商品不再只靠同一个方块换贴图。
changes: 三类各十种商品包装与不同结构；饮料、罐头、纸盒等有轮廓差异。
放大找零数字、允许撤回；调整柜台方向与正门位置。
entries.summaryEn: Products gain genuinely different silhouettes as well as packaging.
changesEn: Thirty products span three categories: bottles, cans, cartons and other shapes.
Change digits become clearer, an undo option is added, and the counter and entrance are repositioned.

entries.title: 0.9：设备、门与仓库扩展
entries.en: Devices, doors and a larger stockroom
entries.summary: 扩展实体工具、身份核验和后仓求生。
changes: 望远镜、当时仍保留的扫描平板、自动玻璃门与钥匙抽屉。
仓库扩建，员工室移到侧边；木板封门取代绊线。
新增角色配饰、身份证头像与条形码，车辆和店面商品更丰富。
entries.summaryEn: Physical tools, ID verification and stockroom survival expand.
changesEn: This historical build still contains the scanner tablet, alongside binoculars, automatic glass doors and the key drawer.
The larger stockroom, side staff room and board barricades replace the tripwire idea.

entries.title: 0.10：卷帘门与真实柜台
entries.summary: 修正卸货门被墙挡住的问题，重做日常设备。
changes: 带内外开关的卷帘门；新增营业区到后仓的第二扇门。
嵌入式扫码窗、CRT电脑、收银机、电话、冷柜与旋转架。
拿证件对电脑直接读卡；拒绝顾客时自动归还证件和退款。
entries.summaryEn: The loading entrance becomes a roller shutter with switches, and a second staff door is added.
changesEn: A recessed scanner, CRT computer, cash register, telephone, fridges and rotating racks improve the workplace.
IDs can be read at the computer; rejecting a customer returns documents and refunds money.

entries.title: 0.11：末班公交与氛围音乐
entries.summary: 加入乘公交抵达、员工制服与上一班同事交接。
changes: 找齐金额后自动结束交易，不再等交小票。
配乐经过多轮试听，最终选择偏冷、压迫的第三版氛围。
这一还原版使用保留下来的已选声音素材。
entries.summaryEn: The last bus, uniform change and handover become the opening sequence.
changesEn: Transactions end when the correct amount is reached, without a separate receipt step.
The music went through multiple auditions. This reconstruction uses the retained, approved audio resources.

entries.title: 0.12：开场电影镜头与引导
entries.summary: 开场公交、换衣、交班和到柜台之间的衔接更完整。
changes: 重新安排远中近景，缩短下车动作，无缝进入操作。
动态光源开关；前几次交互高光逐渐减弱。
entries.summaryEn: The opening camera work becomes more deliberate, from bus arrival to the counter.
changesEn: Getting off the bus is shortened, control returns seamlessly, and a dynamic-lighting option is added.
Early interaction highlights gradually become less prominent.

entries.title: 0.13：角色声线整合
entries.summary: 保留用户喜欢的合成音色，为各角色分配固定声音。
changes: 接入已选司机、同事、主角和顾客声线。
从0.13.1快照结合此前备份还原。
entries.summaryEn: The selected synthetic character voices are integrated.
changesEn: The driver, Ben and Alex use D21, B21 and A21; customers receive different fixed voices.
Restored using the later snapshot and the saved earlier files.

entries.title: 0.13.1：已选声线与对白修复
entries.summary: 司机D21、同事B21、主角A21及不同购物NPC声线接入。
changes: 配音队列、字幕时长与中断/续播；修复重复台词和流程问题。
仍是三晚剧情重写之前的故事。
entries.summaryEn: Dialogue playback and continuity are repaired after voice integration.
changesEn: Adjusts queues, subtitle duration, interruptions and repeated lines.
This is the story before the later three-night rewrite.

entries.title: 0.14.1：三晚主线重写
entries.summary: 挣钱动机、声音模仿、风雪封路与真假接应串起三晚。
changes: 第一晚：假调班电话与柜台录像。
第二晚：停电后的补货声、人影对峙与变形离开。
第三晚：停止营业、核实接应、独自求生；保留开放尾声。
entries.summaryEn: The main story is rebuilt around wages, copied voices, a snowbound road and a false pickup.
changesEn: Night one reveals a fraudulent shift-change call; night two confronts the figure stocking shelves in the dark.
Night three closes the shop and focuses on verification, survival and leaving, with an open-ended coda.

entries.title: 0.14.2：删减与天色变化
entries.summary: 减少多余设备与重复交互，调整天亮和雪景。
changes: 移除扫描平板；交谈开场白不再反复播放。
找零过多只显示文字；四点至六点逐渐变亮。
entries.summaryEn: Unnecessary devices and repeated interactions are removed.
changesEn: The scanner tablet is cut; conversations no longer restart their opening line on every interaction.
Excess change uses a text prompt, while dawn and snow presentation are adjusted.

entries.title: 0.14.3：对白与风雪复测
entries.summary: 继续核对三晚衔接、剧情时序和对白播放。
changes: 修复重复字幕、音频被切断、转场后的操作时机。
保留原来的主线，不重新改故事。
entries.summaryEn: Dialogue, snow and night-to-night continuity are checked again.
changesEn: Fixes repeated subtitles, cut-off speech and the timing of control after cinematic scenes.

entries.title: 0.14.4：连续流程复测
entries.summary: 从第一晚到第三晚连续检查正常流程。
changes: 检查存档恢复、任务显示和分支状态。
entries.summaryEn: A continuous-play pass checks the complete three-night route.
changesEn: Focuses on checkpoint restoration, objectives and branch state.

entries.title: 0.14.5：易错分支与场景
entries.summary: 重点处理找零撤回、拒客、停电门和读档。
changes: 加强夜间切换、电闸演出与控制恢复。
增加冷柜、旋转架和后仓货架，检查碰撞。
entries.summaryEn: Tests change undo, rejected customers, power-failure doors and saved-game recovery.
changesEn: Improves transitions and control handoff; adds shop displays while checking collisions.

entries.title: 0.14.6：交互高光与生存
entries.summary: 加强互动反馈、车辆进出和后期自保。
changes: 八发手枪、生命值、食品饮水与柜子躲藏。
货车进出、更多货架、员工室与死亡惊吓。
entries.summaryEn: Interaction highlights, vehicle movement and survival feedback become more readable.
changesEn: Adds eight handgun rounds, HP, food and water recovery, and a hiding cabinet.
Delivery-truck movement, the staff room and the death scare are revised.

entries.title: 0.15：监控、测试区与后院
entries.en: CCTV, tools and the rear route
entries.summary: 重新组织测试功能，分开卸货区和电闸路线。
changes: 监控分成店内、后仓、后仓外、店前外四路。
增加茂密草丛、杂物遮挡和交班演出；控制渲染负担。
entries.summaryEn: CCTV is reorganized into four views: shop, stockroom, rear exterior and front exterior.
changesEn: Development checks move into a dedicated F2 testing section.
Dense vegetation and debris separate the loading yard from the breaker route, alongside rendering work.

entries.title: 0.16：连续三晚与新住处
entries.en: Three-night flow and the new home
entries.summary: 强化不同夜晚的环境镜头和离开后的结局。
changes: 两晚过渡不再雷同；第三晚新住处结局增加演出。
后院路线、装饰、货车离场与公告板地图。
entries.summaryEn: The three-night flow and the ending at the new home receive a further pass.
changesEn: Night transitions use different environmental shots rather than repeating the same scene.
Adds the rear-yard barrier, truck exit details, surrounding scenery and the physical noticeboard map.

entries.title: 0.17.2：节奏、躲藏与开场修复
entries.summary: 先固定内容，改善可玩性而不是继续添加系统。
changes: 营业节奏与辨伪线索调整；柜子不再是无条件安全区。
多人格试玩记录、油泵授权、公交和开场店灯修复。
entries.summaryEn: The focus shifts from adding systems to improving the existing experience.
changesEn: Adjusts shop pacing and observation clues; hiding is no longer automatically safe when seen.
Includes fuel-pump authorization, bus-model and opening-light fixes.

entries.title: 0.18：碰撞与建筑周边
entries.summary: 当前玩家版之前的开发版本。
changes: 集中检查门、物件与行走区域的碰撞。
补充建筑左侧和周边环境装饰。
entries.summaryEn: The development build immediately before the player edition.
changesEn: A collision pass checks doors, objects and movement areas, with more detail around the building and its left side.

entries.title: 玩家版 UI1
entries.summary: 从开发工程中独立出玩家试玩包。
changes: 移除F2与测试入口，保留三晚流程与独立玩家存档。
entries.summaryEn: The first separate player package removes F2 and development entry points.
changesEn: Keeps the three-night campaign and a separate player save namespace.

entries.title: 玩家版 UI2
entries.summary: 尝试实物电脑菜单与极简游戏内HUD。
changes: 菜单放进收银台CRT电脑，任务和物品提示减少常驻显示。
entries.summaryEn: The menu moves onto the physical CRT, with a minimal in-game HUD.
changesEn: Task and inventory information become less permanently visible.

entries.title: 玩家版 UI3
entries.summary: 恢复外景标题页，开始按钮与设置留在电脑。
changes: 先进入电脑菜单，再真正开始游戏；此版使用暗场转场。
entries.summaryEn: The exterior title screen returns; settings and the actual Start button remain on the computer.
changesEn: This version uses a dark transition between the two menu views.

entries.title: 玩家版 UI4
entries.summary: 从暗场改成可见的连续镜头。
changes: 穿过玻璃，避开实体；此版移镜约9.4秒。
entries.summaryEn: The dark cut is replaced with a visible camera journey through the glass.
changesEn: The camera avoids solid objects, but takes approximately 9.4 seconds.

entries.title: 玩家版 UI5
entries.summary: 把转场缩短到两秒。
changes: 按钮约0.3秒淡入；此版仍有较明显的路径转向。
entries.summaryEn: The camera journey is shortened to two seconds.
changesEn: Buttons fade in quickly after arrival, although the route still has a noticeable turn.

entries.title: 最新玩家版：0.18.0 · UI6
entries.summary: 两秒连续滑到电脑前，直接穿过玻璃；从头到尾平滑转向，不再突然拐弯。
changes: 保持原来的外景标题页；电脑内调整设置并开始游戏。
停稳后按钮淡入；反向返回同样平滑。
保留已确认的剧情、配音、配乐和三晚流程。
entries.summaryEn: The current player edition glides directly through the glass to the computer in two seconds.
changesEn: One continuous curve and gradual rotation replace the abrupt turn; buttons appear after the camera settles.
The confirmed three-night story, voices and music remain intact.
